entities.name: Al-Rabi' ibn Yunus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Al-Rabīʾ ibn Yūnus ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Farwa was a freedman who became one of the leading ministers of the early Abbasid Caliphate, serving under the caliphs al-Mansur, al-Mahdi and al-Hadi.
